nudge.message: You can have SimpleCRM as an app right on your home screen.

iosModal.title: Add to Home Screen
iosModal.step1: In your browser, tap the Share button.

tutorial.actionHint: Continue by doing it on the page

welcome.title: Welcome to SimpleCRM
welcome.body: Every page has its own tour of the advanced features — start it anytime with the ? icon up top. The app runs without a mouse too: ⌘K searches, N starts a deal, and the ? key shows every shortcut.

widgets.title: Arrange the Overview your way
widgets.body: The Edit layout button lets you rearrange, add and remove widgets — the catalog holds Weighted pipeline value, Sales cycle length or Goal progress. In edit mode a widget also gets its own date-range picker.

quickActions.title: Quick actions
quickActions.body: The Quick actions widget starts a new deal in one click — and the N key does it from anywhere. Add tiles for a company, contact or event via Edit layout → Add widget.

cardActions.title: Cards do more than they show
cardActions.body: Hover a card: the crown marks a win, the red cross a loss — we'll ask for the reason. Dragging a card onto the bottom bar loses it too.

quickActions.title: The bolt = act without leaving the board
quickActions.body: Open ⚡ on any card: email, event, note or a logged call — everything lands in the deal's timeline.

preview.title: Peek without clicking
preview.body: Hold the cursor over a card — you'll see the last action, notes and any upcoming events.

filters.title: Filters above the board
filters.body: The Won within… switch trims ONLY the Won column — the other stages stay whole. Next to it, flip the board to My deals or a colleague's.

health.title: We watch forgotten deals
health.body: A badge lights up on a deal that hasn't moved for a while — set the day threshold in Settings.

ares.title: Just the ID — ARES fills the rest
ares.body: When adding a company, enter only its registration number (IČO) — we pull the name, address and legal form from the public ARES registry.

bulkEmail.title: Bulk email with merge fields
bulkEmail.body: Select companies and send a personalized bulk email — fields like {kontakt_jmeno} or {firma} resolve per recipient. Take the text from a saved template; the History link shows how past sends did.

ownership.title: Companies don't rot in drawers
ownership.body: A company with no orders frees up for colleagues after the configured period — the date shows in the Lock expires column. See who's unowned via Owner → Unclaimed.

csv.title: Export exactly what you see
csv.body: Download CSV honors the active filters and search — you export precisely the list on your screen.

mainContact.title: A company's main contact
mainContact.body: The star in a company's detail (Contacts tab) sets the main contact — it then prefills into emails and new deals.

status.title: Every deal — including lost ones
status.body: The table keeps open, won and lost deals together. Hover the red Lost chip to see the loss reason; this filter switches between states.

csv.title: Filtered export
csv.body: Download CSV exports exactly what you've filtered — status, stage and owner included.

openDetail.title: Open a detail
openDetail.body: Click a deal's name — the detail opens right here, full history included, without losing your filters.

timeline.title: The timeline is the deal's whole story
timeline.body: Stage changes, emails, calls and notes on one timeline — edits even show what exactly changed. And a won or lost deal comes back via the Reopen button in the header.

bcc.title: Get your regular mail in here too
bcc.body: Click the ? next to the page title — it holds your personal BCC address. Add it as a BCC on customer messages and the email files itself under the right company and deal.

filters.title: Nothing gets lost
filters.body: Mail without a matched company waits under the Unmatched filter. The Company and Deal filters pull up one case's correspondence, and search covers message text and addresses too.

tracking.title: Know what they read
tracking.body: Switch the filter to Sent: messages show Opened and Clicked chips, and a failed delivery shows an Error chip. Click a subject to open the whole thread.

google.title: Google Calendar connection
google.body: Connect the calendar to Google in Settings → Integrations. Your Google events then show up here as well.

deals.title: Events belong to deals
deals.body: Attach an event to a deal — it shows in the deal's timeline and in the card preview on the board. One checkbox also sends it to your Google Calendar.

catalog.title: Widgets you won't find elsewhere
catalog.body: The reports catalog also holds Loss reasons, Stale deals, Won vs. paid and Lead → deal conversion. Add them via the Edit layout button.

period.title: Period and team
period.body: The bar up top switches the period for the whole report — custom date ranges included. With manager rights you can narrow the report to a team or a single salesperson.

deltaCsv.title: Comparison and export
deltaCsv.body: Every metric is compared to the equally long previous period — the arrow next to a number is that change. Download the whole report with the CSV button.
